name: Coirbre
text: Coirbre is a variant spelling of Cairbre, the common early Irish name borne by kings, heroes, and poets. MacKillop treats Coirbre as a cross-reference to his entry on Cairbre.

okr.objective: Coirbre is a variant spelling of the name Cairbre.
key_results: MacKillop lists Coirbre as a cross-reference to Cairbre.
Cairbre names many early Irish kings, heroes, and poets.
